source_note: Execution checkout plus exact input digests; evaluated worktree bytes may be committed subsequently. Hosted --check replays fixed outcomes without rewriting the receipt.

limits.scope: Same-identity assessment correction only; not arbitrary assertion/scenario/source admission.
limits.correction_predicate: Application metadata only; no native predicate added.
limits.declaration: Append immutable declaration after both versions are issued; declaration time must be no earlier than either recorded assessment time. No claim of causal/event/interval order.
limits.branching: One parent per corrected version; many children per prior version. No automatic latest or authoritative branch.
limits.source: Correction declaration source is distinct from assessment/result sources; none establishes independent support.
limits.rdf: Existing native named-graph projection is unchanged; correction lineage remains SQL metadata.
